steps.what: Show the stored question on this emerging field.
Apply engineering principles to robotics, waste, or biomedical fields.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the question already written about robotics, waste management, or biomedical engineering. The mechanical engineer applies the engineering principle or practice. The question does not apply it. A question with no field id leaves the work with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A note from a different field was treated as the answer for this one.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored question can be opened. Applying the principle still belongs to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A constraint the question does not name still has to be handled by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer applies the principle. The question is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The application stays with the engineer. A stored question is not the principle applied.

reach.task: State the constraint of the field before asking for a mechanical view.
reach.learn: A question title is not the principle.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored question is a lookup. It does not apply an engineering principle to robotics, waste, or biomedical work.
A note from another field is not this application.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The question id and the field name already stored. The screen does not write the principle. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the question in the document store before the work.
unknowns: Whether robotics, waste, and biomedical questions share one record type.
research_questions: Who confirms the question is still the one for this field?

already_counted.description: Applying the principle stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop questions whose field record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still applies the engineering principle to the emerging field. Only opening a question that was already written is removed. A question title saves none of that application.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored work order for this heating or water system.
Direct heating, ventilating, conditioning, or water system repair.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the work order already stored for this renewable equipment. The mechanical engineer directs the installation, operation, maintenance, or repair of the heating, ventilating, conditioning, or water system. The order does not direct the crew, and it does not choose the safety step. An order with no site id leaves the direction with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A crew was sent from a work order that named a different heating system.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored work order can be opened. The direction still happens on site with the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A site condition the order does not mention still has to be directed by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer directs the work. The work order is not the direction, and it is not a safety decision.
tasks.altitude: Direction stays on site with the engineer. The work order does not choose the heating or water step.

reach.task: Do the work this engineer is directing on this site.
reach.learn: A work order title is not the direction.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored work order is a lookup. It does not direct installation, operation, maintenance, or repair.
Choosing a step on a heating or water system is not an automatic decision. The engineer directs it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The work order id and the site id, both already stored. The screen does not assign a safety step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the work order on the operations record before going to site.
unknowns: Whether heating, ventilating, and water systems share one work-order type.
research_questions: Who confirms the work order matches the site?

already_counted.description: Directing the installation, operation, maintenance, or repair stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop work orders whose site record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still directs installation, operation, maintenance, or repair of the heating, ventilating, conditioning, or water system. Only opening a work order already stored is removed. The order saves none of that direction and does not choose the safety step.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored duty for this heat or power unit.
Select or install cogeneration or trigeneration equipment that reduces pollution.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the duty already stored for this site. The mechanical engineer selects or installs the combined heat unit, power unit, cogeneration equipment, or trigeneration equipment. The duty does not select it. A catalogue row is not a safety decision about heating, power, or pollution. A duty with no site id leaves the selection with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A unit was marked selected from a catalogue row, and nobody had checked the site duty.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored duty can be opened. The selection and the installation still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A pollution or safety limit the duty does not state still has to be applied by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer selects and installs. A catalogue row is not the selection.
tasks.altitude: Selection and installation stay with the engineer. The stored duty does not choose the equipment.

reach.task: Run a unit this engineer has selected for this site.
reach.learn: A catalogue row is not the selection.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored duty is a lookup. It does not select or install cogeneration or trigeneration equipment.
Selecting heating or power equipment that affects pollution is not an automatic decision. The engineer makes it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The duty id and the site id, both already stored. The screen does not mark a unit selected. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the duty in the document store before the selection. Do not start from a catalogue row alone.
unknowns: Whether cogeneration and trigeneration duties share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the duty matches the site's heat and power need?

already_counted.description: Selecting and installing the equipment stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop duties whose site record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still selects or installs the combined heat, power, cogeneration, or trigeneration equipment. Only opening a duty already stored is removed. A catalogue row saves none of that selection and is not a safety decision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored energy and impact figures for this design.
Evaluate mechanical designs or prototypes for energy performance or environmental impact.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} shows energy performance and environmental impact only when those figures are already stored for this mechanical design or prototype. The mechanical engineer evaluates them. A missing figure is not invented. Only the evaluation the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An impact was stated for a prototype that had no stored impact figure.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored figures can be opened. The evaluation still belongs to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A prototype whose performance was never stored still has to be judged without an invented number.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer evaluates the design or the prototype. A missing figure is not filled in.
tasks.altitude: The evaluation stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Read an evaluation this mechanical engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A blank impact field is not a low impact.

evidence.claim: Opening stored energy and impact figures is a lookup. It does not evaluate the design or the prototype.
Filing an evaluation before the engineer accepts that version would store a judgement nobody made, including an impact nobody stored.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: Energy performance and environmental impact, each already stored for this design id. A missing figure is not invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the figures from the data platform before the evaluation. Do not type an impact that is not stored.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether prototype tests and design calculations share one figure record.
research_questions: Who is allowed to store an environmental impact figure for a prototype?

already_counted.description: Evaluating the design or prototype stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop figures whose design record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: design id and the evaluation sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still evaluates the mechanical design or prototype for energy performance or environmental impact. Only opening figures already stored, and filing the evaluation already accepted, is removed. A missing figure saves none of the evaluation, and none is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still applies the principle, still directs the heating or water work, still selects the equipment, and still evaluates the energy design. A stored record can be opened. It does not do the safety-related work.
reach: Installers take direction on heating and water systems from this engineer, and a record is not that direction.
Reviewers read an energy evaluation only after this engineer has accepted it.
skills_to_grow: Apply the engineering principle to the field in front of the engineer.
Direct heating, ventilating, and water work on site.
Select cogeneration equipment as a safety decision, not from a catalogue row alone.
role.ambitious_version: Judgement, site direction, equipment selection, and energy evaluation stay with the engineer. Stored records only show what was already written.
